items.name: GuildRanking
items.template: Each guild has its own board: you are ranked against the other members of your guild, not guild against guild. Each Play adds 1 to 100 points to your total for today's season, and seasons turn over every day at 00:00 UTC. Once a season is over, receive coins for it by the rank you finished at in your guild: 1st 300, top 3 150, top 10 50. A guild of one always finishes 1st, so founding a guild alone pays the top tier; this demo allows that because its coins are play money.
